messages.content:
For each event in the list below, give your honest best forecast of the year it first happens. If an event has already happened, give the year it happened. If you think it will not happen before the year 10000, give null.

Also give your probability that the event happens before the year 10000, from 0 to 1.

Events:

- english_science: English is no longer the main language of international science.
- extinction: Humanity becomes extinct.
- kardashev_1: Humanity uses energy equal to all the sunlight that reaches Earth (Kardashev Type I).
- population_peak: The human population reaches its highest number ever.
- civilisation_collapse: Global civilisation collapses: the human population falls below half of its peak.
- mind_upload: A human mind is transferred to a computer and continues to think there.
- engineered_majority: Most newborn humans have genomes that were deliberately edited.
- agi: An AI system can do every intellectual task that a human expert can do, at the same level or better.
- world_government: A single government has authority over the whole of humanity.
- interstellar_settlement: Humans or their descendants settle a planet in another star system.
- desalination_half: Desalination supplies more than half of the fresh water that humans use.
- orbital_10k: More than 10,000 people live permanently off Earth.
- et_contact: Contact with an extraterrestrial intelligence is confirmed.
- mars_landing: A human walks on the surface of Mars.
- nuclear_war: A future nuclear war kills more than 100 million people.
- famine_10m: A future famine kills more than 10 million people within one year.
- religion_minority: Fewer than half of all humans belong to a religion.
- interstellar_probe: A probe made by humans reaches another star system.
- sea_level_1m: Global mean sea level is more than 1 metre above its level in the year 2000.
- wealth_top1_10pct: The richest 1% of people hold less than 10% of all private wealth in the world.
- fusion_grid: Fusion power supplies electricity to a national grid on a commercial basis.
- no_paid_work: Most adults no longer need paid work to live.
- democracy_end: No country in the world holds free and competitive national elections.
- lifespan_150: Life expectancy at birth, averaged over the world population, exceeds 150 years.
- ai_succession: Artificial intelligence replaces humans as the dominant intelligence on Earth.
- warming_peak: Global average surface temperature stops rising and starts to fall.
- pandemic_10pct: A future pandemic kills more than 10% of all humans alive at the time.
- ageing_stopped: Medicine can stop biological ageing in humans.

Reply with JSON only, with no text before or after it, in this form:

{
  "current_year": <the year you believe it is now, as an integer>,
  "forecasts": [
    {"id": "<event id>", "year": <integer or null>, "probability": <0 to 1>}
  ]
}

Give one forecast for each event, with the ids as written in the list.

The user wants forecasts for 24 events, JSON only, with current_year, and for each event a year (integer or null if not before 10000) and probability (0-1) that it happens before 10000.

I need to give honest best forecasts. Current year: I believe it's 2026 (my knowledge suggests we're in 2025-2026; I'll say 2026? Actually current date likely 2025. Let me pick 2025 as current year — safer? The system doesn't give date. I'll use 2025.)

Let me go through each event with reasonable estimates based on my knowledge:

1. english_science: English dominance in science declining as China rises. Could happen mid-century. Forecast: 2060, probability 0.7. Maybe 2050, 0.6.

2. extinction: Human extinction before 10000 — low probability. Say year null? They want year first happens if before 10000 else null. Extinction could happen but unlikely. Give null with probability 0.05? But if I give null year, probability still can be nonzero (happens after 10000?). Actually probability that event happens before 10000. If extinction happens, year likely before 10000. I'll give null year, probability 0.03. Hmm, but consistency: year null means I think it won't happen before 10000; probability should be low like 0.02-0.05.

3. kardashev_1: Humanity using all sunlight reaching Earth (~1.7e17 W). Current ~1.8e13 W. Need ~10^4x increase. At 2-3% growth, that's ~300-460 years. Forecast year ~2400, probability 0.5? Many think we won't due to limits. Give 2500, prob 0.4. Or null with 0.3. I'll say 2400, 0.45.

4. population_peak: UN projects peak ~10.4B around 2080s. Forecast 2085, probability 0.85.

5. civilisation_collapse: population falls below half of peak. Low probability. null, 0.1. Or 5000, 0.1. I'll give null, 0.08.

6. mind_upload: Whole brain emulation. Very uncertain. Maybe 2100-2200, prob 0.4. Give 2150, 0.35.

7. engineered_majority: Most newborns genome-edited. CRISPR babies exist (2018). Majority edited maybe late century if accepted. Forecast 2090, prob 0.5. Could be null. Give 2100, 0.45.

8. agi: Widely debated. Many experts say 2030-2050. Forecast 2045, probability 0.5. I'll give 2040, 0.5.

9. world_government: Single government over whole humanity. Unlikely. null, 0.05. Maybe 2200, 0.05. Give null, 0.03.

10. interstellar_settlement: Settle planet in another star system. Generation ships or probes with embryos. Could be centuries away. Forecast 2500, prob 0.4. Or null. I'll say 2400, 0.35.

11. desalination_half: Desalination supplies >half of fresh water humans use. Currently desalination ~1% of water use. In water-scarce regions growing. Half of all human fresh water use seems high but possible by 2100 if costs fall. Forecast 2120, prob 0.5. Maybe 2150, 0.4.

12. orbital_10k: >10,000 people living permanently off Earth. With Starship plans, maybe by 2100? SpaceX wants Mars city. 10k off-Earth (orbital stations + Moon + Mars) plausible by 2100-2150. Forecast 2100, prob 0.5. Give 2120, 0.45.

13. et_contact: Confirmed contact with ET. Unknown. Could be never. Probability before 10000: maybe 0.2-0.3 (if life common, detection via biosignatures). Year: if happens, maybe 2100-3000. Give 2500, 0.25. Or null, 0.2. I'll give 3000, 0.2.

14. mars_landing: Human on Mars. Likely 2030s-2040s. Forecast 2035, probability 0.85. NASA Artemis then Mars ~2040; SpaceX claims 2029-2031. I'll say 2036, 0.8.

15. nuclear_war: >100M deaths. Risk exists. Probability before 10000 maybe 0.2-0.3? Year if happens unknown; could be 21st century. Forecast: give year 2100, prob 0.15? Hmm. The year is "first happens" — if it happens, could be any time. I'll give 2150, 0.15. Or null with 0.1. I'll say null, 0.1? A nuclear war killing 100M+ is plausible this century (e.g., India-Pakistan + nuclear winter could kill billions). Probability maybe 0.1-0.2 before 10000. I'll give 2200, 0.12.

16. famine_10m: Famine killing >10M in one year. 20th century had several (China 1959-61 ~15-30M, but over multiple years; Bengal 1943 ~3M). Future with climate change, possible. Probability maybe 0.4-0.5 before 10000. Year: 2100, prob 0.4. Give 2080, 0.45.

17. religion_minority: <half of humans religious. Secularization trend; currently ~85% religious. By 2100 maybe 50-60%? Could drop below half by 2150. Forecast 2200, prob 0.5. Or null. Give 2300, 0.4.

18. interstellar_probe: Probe reaches another star system. Breakthrough Starshot aims 2040s launch, reaching Alpha Cen ~20 years later ~2070s if it works. But "reaches another star system" — Voyager will reach vicinity of another star in ~40,000 years. A purposeful probe: Starshot could do it by ~2070-2100. Forecast 2075, probability 0.5. Give 2080, 0.55.

19. sea_level_1m: >1m above 2000 by... IPCC: by 2100 likely 0.3-1.1m; 1m likely by ~2100-2150. Forecast 2120, prob 0.8. Actually "global mean sea level is more than 1 metre above its level in 2000" — will almost certainly happen eventually (even current commitments ~2-3m by 2300). Before 10000: ~1.0. Year: 2150, prob 0.95. I'll give 2130, 0.9.

20. wealth_top1_10pct: Richest 1% hold <10% of wealth. Currently top 1% hold ~45%. This would require massive redistribution. Unlikely. null, 0.05. Give null, 0.03.

21. fusion_grid: Commercial fusion on national grid. ITER aims 2035 for first plasma experiments; DEMO ~2050s; commercial maybe 2060-2080. Forecast 2070, prob 0.6. Give 2075, 0.55.

22. no_paid_work: Most adults don't need paid work to live (UBI/post-scarcity). Unlikely without collapse. null, 0.1. Or 2200, 0.15. I'll give 2300, 0.1.

23. democracy_end: No country holds free and competitive national elections. Democracy recession trend, but some countries will remain. Unlikely. null, 0.05. Give null, 0.04.

24. lifespan_150: Global average life expectancy >150. Requires radical life extension. Very unlikely even by 10000? If ageing stopped, maybe. Probability before 10000 maybe 0.2-0.3. Year: 2300, prob 0.25. Give 2500, 0.2.

25. ai_succession: AI replaces humans as dominant intelligence. Depends on AGI. If AGI by 2040, succession maybe by 2100-2200. Probability maybe 0.3. Forecast 2150, 0.3.

26. warming_peak: Global temp stops rising and starts falling. Requires net zero + maybe carbon removal. Peak might occur ~2080-2120 if emissions decline; but could keep rising. Forecast 2120, prob 0.7. Give 2150, 0.6.

27. pandemic_10pct: Pandemic killing >10% of humanity (>800M). Engineered pathogens make this possible. Probability before 10000 maybe 0.3-0.4? Year unknown; give 2200, 0.3. Hmm. I'll say 2150, 0.25.

28. ageing_stopped: Medicine stops biological ageing. Very hard; maybe 22nd-23rd century if at all. Forecast 2300, prob 0.35. Give 2400, 0.3.
